'''Pestilent Strike''' is a [[melee]] [[strike]] [[skill]] that deals [[chaos damage]] and applies [[poison]]. If the poisoned enemy dies while poisoned it will inflict other nearby enemies with another chaos [[damage over time]] debuff.

==Skill functions and interactions==
The base debuff radius is 2.7m.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/cvzqvq/angry_reddit_post_pestilent_strike_aoe_makes_it/ez8benl/</ref>

Enemies killed while under the effect of Pestilent Strike’s signature debuff will leave no corpse. This can be useful for bypassing some monsters’ on-death effects. It does not prevent the poison spreading effect of {{psl|Master Toxicist}} or {{il|Bino's Kitchen Knife}}. 

Multiple debuffs can be on the same monster, but only the highest damage debuff will cause damage at any given time. 

The debuff requires an enemy to die with poison on it near the enemy you want the debuff on. For solo enemy fights, {{il|vaal breach}} can spawn enemies to spread the debuff.

The debuff takes half of the poison damage left on the monster when it died and deals it incrementally over 1 second. The gem's advanced description specifies ''{{c|help|(The Expected Damage of Poison is its Damage per second multiplied by its Duration)}}.''

*'''Example''' - An enemy dies with 3 stacks of equivalent poison damage (A, B, C), with each stack having a remaining duration of 2 seconds, 4 seconds, and 6 seconds respectively. The debuff would then deal 0.5 * ((A * 2) + (B * 4) + (C * 6)). In this case, the debuff would be dealing 6x the DPS of a single stack of poison.

==Damage Calculations==
===Scaling===
Pestilent Strikes debuff can scale poison damage in unique ways that would not be beneficial to most other poison attacks. Some examples:
*Because all sources of poisons transfer on the debuff, spells, minions and even other players with poison, can help scale the damage.
*Poison duration will increase the damage per second of the debuff. The [[assassin]] ascendancy passive [[Toxic Delivery]] with many poisons landed per second is the largest source of poison duration.
